synthesizedFacts.fact: Neutrogena's Rapid Wrinkle Repair products contain retinol, a form of Vitamin A, which is known to improve the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and dark spots.
The products are formulated with hyaluronic acid, which helps to hydrate and plump the skin.
Users may experience mild redness, tingling, or flaking when starting retinol products, which are normal indications of the product working.
